# TC.DeviceInfo

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.DeviceInfo"></a>

### TC.DeviceInfo

Fresh complete target description. ID is opaque, not coordinates: replacement
at the same location gets a new identity. Descriptions/settings can change while
the identity stays the same. Nonconfigurable real targets remain in inventory.

### configurable

True when the current summary contains writable root settings.

```text
boolean
```

### configuration

```text
TC.ConfigurationSummary
```

